_comment: The build popup (wire id 25), work order 180 C. Geometry and state: screens/build_queue/bqwire.py; drawing and marks: bqdraw.py. Each mark is held by check 090q and named in ~/orionlayerv3-dev/v3_projektstatus.md.

words._note: DEVIATION `button_words`: the six buttons carry their words in COLBLDG.LBX art (colbldg.cpp:346-364); HD draws them as HUD buttons with the words in code.

marks.deviation_ship_row_dim: A ship or other row is never dimmed. The original dims a design by the colony's bases and the design's size, and a row by Colony_Can_Build_Product_ (colbldg.cpp:625-653) — a rule this screen does not copy.
marks.deviation_hd_font: Text in the HD font at a size from the native line pitch, fitted to the original's width (the Leaders screen's rule).
marks.omission_description: The selection panel's description comes from HELP.LBX by tech application (Print_App_Description_, colbldg.cpp:1056-1076); the map from application to help entry is not read, so no description is drawn.
marks.omission_product_picture: The selection's picture (colbldg.cpp:1108-1113) is the player's art; not drawn.
marks.omission_design_stats: A design's nine stat lines (Draw_Ship_Design_Info_, colbldg.cpp:1205-1303) need the weapon and system name tables; the design's name, cost and build time are drawn.
marks.omission_delete_hint: The original prints 'delete %s' over the queue row ITS pointer is on (colbldg.cpp:714-750); HD's pointer is not the game's, and the hint is not drawn.
marks.hd_extension_summary_follows_hd_pointer: The summary shows the item under HD's pointer, where the original's follows its own (_scanned_prod, colbldg.cpp:825); hovering sends nothing.
